headline: Grigoriy Zatravkin advances to 7th on ARC-3

sections.text: Grigoriy Zatravkin gained 4.39 points to reach 45.02, moving from 11th to 7th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
He is now among the board’s 18 gold places; the 18th-place gold line is 38.20.
